text:
Sam: Heads-up — schema migration for users.profile_meta tonight 02:00-02:20 UTC. Dual-write window 02:00-02:10. Need owners for smoke + rollback readiness. I'll be on-call.

Tara: I'm smoke owner. Will run the smoke checklist and watch traces. What's the rollback plan?

Juan: I'll own rollback steps. Quick Q: backfill job — do we run it after dual-write closes or during?

Liam: Backfill should run after cutover to avoid write conflicts. We'll do bounded backfill by PK ranges. I can kick off at ~02:12.

Sam: Plan outline:
- 02:00 start DDL migration (non-destructive add column)
- 02:04 enable dual-write in service layer
- 02:00-02:10 dual-write window
- 02:10 cutover reads to new column and stop dual-write
- 02:12 start backfill (bounded)
Canary traffic: 1% -> 10% -> 100% over 02:11-02:15. Rollback: flip feature-flag to re-enable old column + route reads back, run rollback script. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/migrations/users-profile-meta

Tara: link for runbook received, thanks. I'll follow the checklist there.

DeployBot: Deploy window reserved: 02:00-02:30 UTC. Migration command queued: `rdb migrate users.profile_meta --txn-mode=blocking`

Sam: DB note: bump app DB pool max_conn to 120 during backfill. @Liam can you verify replicas catch up before cutover?

Liam: Will verify replica lag < 100ms at 01:55 and again at 02:09. If not healthy, we abort.

Juan: If we abort after dual-write enabled, rollback steps (short): 1) re-enable writes to old column 2) switch read routing back 3) run cleanup job to drop partial new data. I have `rollback_users_profile_meta.sh` ready locally.

Tara: :thumbsup: I'll run smoke: basic read/write on profile, login flow, and webhook delivery. I'll post results here at check-ins.

Sam: Also drain sticky sessions on web nodes and watch API latency + 5xx. Abort & rollback if >1% 5xx over 5m or any data-corruption signs.

Tara: Understood. I'll post checks at 02:05, 02:11, and 02:20.

Liam: Ping me 5m before start for final go/no-go. I'll do replica check + infra watch.

Sam: Thanks everyone. Tagging PD: @oncall — be available for escalation. :rocket:
